achievements.name: A bug in the system
achievements.desc: Find and read the scruffy note in the Scabarite Cavern.
achievements.tip: Find and read the scruffy note in the Scabarite Cavern. The scruffy note is obtained by searching the papers on the table in the centre of the Scabarite Cavern.

achievements.name: A Cultist's Journey
achievements.desc: Complete the 'A Cultist's Journey' tasks from the Curator.
achievements.tip: Complete a series of tasks with the same name.

achievements.name: A Mini Shipment
achievements.desc: Loot the trunk in the Temple of Aminishi.
achievements.tip: Loot the trunk in the azure room of the Temple of Aminishi using a trunk key.

achievements.name: A New Direction
achievements.desc: Reunite Irwinsson with his lost compass.
achievements.tip: Reunite Irwinsson with his lost compass.

achievements.name: A Sliver of Silver Helps the Sanguine Go Down
achievements.page: A Sliver of Silver Helps the Sanguine Go Down
achievements.desc: Learn how to smith more durable havensilver.
achievements.tip: Learn how to smith more durable havensilver metal from Liat.

achievements.name: Advanced Sweeping
achievements.desc: Fully enchant your broomstick after the 'Swept Away' quest.
achievements.tip: Fully enchant the broomstick by bringing it to various magic users around the world. Temporary boosts, such as a magic potion, can be used to reach the requirements, but the god banner boost does not work as a boost for these requirements.

achievements.name: Aereck's Old Bones
achievements.desc: Claim ancient bones from Father Aereck after 'The Restless Ghost'.
achievements.tip: Finish the Restless Ghost quest, or claim the ancient bones by talking to Father Aereck if the player has completed the quest before the bones were added as a reward.

achievements.name: After the Close
achievements.desc: Unlock the Closure's robes cosmetic override outfit after 'Once Upon a Time in Gielinor'.

links.name: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor

achievements.tip: Unlock Closure's robes cosmetic override outfit after completion of the Once Upon a Time in Gielinor quest.

achievements.name: After the Flood
achievements.desc: Find and read Elidinis' memoir.
achievements.tip: Read the book After The Flood. The book can be obtained as a drop from the Gate of Elidinis skilling boss.

achievements.name: Aged Journal
achievements.desc: Find and read the Aged Journal in Daemonheim.
achievements.tip: Find and read the aged journal in Daemonheim. Accessing the area requires level 103 Archaeology and 95 Dungeoneering (unboostable).

achievements.name: Ali the Trader
achievements.desc: Unlock all Rogue Trader merchandise.
achievements.tip: Unlock all Rogue Trader merchandise from Ali Morrisane.

achievements.name: All Rise
achievements.desc: Complete all Court Cases and claim a gavel and the 'the Detective' title from the courthouse clerk.
achievements.tip: Complete all sixteen Court Cases and claim both the gavel and 'the Detective' title from the clerk. A fast and AFK method to obtain the necessary court summons for this achievement is pickpocketing Al Kharid warriors, which requires no combat, level 25 Thieving, and has a reasonable loot chance. Another method is by opening the caskets from Managing Miscellania when subjects are assigned to fish.

achievements.name: Am I a good boy yet?
achievements.page: Am I a good boy yet?
achievements.desc: Get a gift from the stray dog after he moves into Fort Forinthry.
achievements.tip: Get a gift from the stray dog after he moves into Fort Forinthry near the chapel. It requires players to complete the quest Princess and the Pauper.

achievements.name: An Exploration of Havenhythe
achievements.desc: Find all volumes of Kaleb's Travel Journal.
achievements.tip: Find Kaleb's travel journal - volume I, volume II, and volume III in Havenhythe.

achievements.name: Angs Off My Ring
achievements.desc: Return the wedding ring after 'The Light Within'.
achievements.tip: Get the ancient elven wedding ring drop from Crystal Shapeshifters and use it on Angof.

achievements.name: Animalingual
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the cramulet.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the cramulet. This is done by first creating it using a ghostspeak and monkeyspeak amulet and then adding the remaining speaking amulets to it (using either a catspeak amulet or its enchanted version).

achievements.name: Annihilator
achievements.desc: Earn 'the Annihilator' title by fighting all four nihil at once.
achievements.tip: Obtain [Name] the Annihilator title by defeating all four nihil at once in the Pit in Freneskae as a boss fight during or after Fate of the Gods. If engaged after the quest, players must engage them by selecting "Yes - replay the boss fight!" while standing in the middle of the room. Players must be engaged in combat with all four nihil before defeating them or the achievement will not be completed.

achievements.name: Another One Scabarites The Dust
achievements.desc: Kill elite profane scabarites with the primed keris equipped to upgrade it after 'Beneath Scabaras' Sands'.
achievements.tip: Another One Scabarites The Dust is an achievement that requires killing 200 elite Profane Scabarites with the primed keris or the augmented variant equipped at the time of their death, upgrading the keris into a consecrated keris or the augmented variant.

achievements.name: Any Odd Chicken
achievements.desc: Claim Professor Oddenstein's extra rewards after 'Ernest the Chicken'.
achievements.tip: Complete the Ernest the Chicken quest, or talk to Professor Oddenstein in Draynor manor if the player completed the quest before 15 December 2009 when 10 eggs and 300 feathers were added as a reward.

achievements.name: Ape A'hollow
achievements.desc: Unblock the hollow log and tunnel shortcut after 'Fairy Tale III'.

links.name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

achievements.tip: Clear shortcuts on Ape Atoll and Gu'Tanoth during or after A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

achievements.name: Are You Needing Access?
achievements.desc: Gain access to the secret treasure room from 'Do No Evil'.
achievements.tip: Access the Apmeken tomb after completion of the Do No Evil quest and also requires level 80 Agility.

achievements.name: Are You The Keymaster?
achievements.desc: Add all valid keys to the steel key ring after 'One Small Favour'.
achievements.tip: Add all valid keys to the steel key ring after the One Small Favour quest.

achievements.name: Argh, it burns!
achievements.desc: Find out who in Amberfell has the 'monthly affliction'.
achievements.tip: Use either Wolfbane or a reforged Sunspear on the villagers of Amberfell.

achievements.name: Arise from the Ash
achievements.desc: Defeat the phoenix once, after 'In Pyre Need'.
achievements.tip: Kill the phoenix after the In Pyre Need quest.

achievements.name: Armadylean Expert
achievements.desc: Restored a collection of Armadylean artefacts.
achievements.tip: Have restored all Armadylean artefacts from the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.

achievements.name: Around the World in Six Ways
achievements.page: Around the World in Six Ways
achievements.desc: Unlock all hot-air balloon travel routes.
achievements.tip: Go to each destination using the balloon transport system after Enlightened Journey. The player can store logs with any of the hot-air balloon pilots which are converted into charges. Each location requires a different number of charges to both unlock and travel to after unlocking.

achievements.name: As Clear as a Crystal Seed
achievements.page: As Clear as a Crystal Seed
achievements.desc: Unlock the Temple of Light teleport after 'Within the Light'.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Temple of Light teleport on the crystal teleport seed. This can be unlocked by talking to Eluned with a charged seed after completing Mourning's End Part II. If The Light Within is completed, players must talk to Isylwn in the Ithell district of Prifddinas instead.

achievements.name: As Taxed as a Yak
achievements.desc: Gain access to the Contraband Yak Produce shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Jatizso Contraband Yak Produce shop owned by Vanligga Gastfrihet by offering to pay for her taxes during or after the Fremennik Isles quest. The achievement is unlocked after talking to her after the quest again.

achievements.name: Azacorax's Rewards
achievements.desc: Speak to Azacorax after 'Rune Memories' and gain Magic or Prayer XP.
achievements.tip: Speak with the lesser demon in the 1st floor of the Wizards' Tower after completion of Rune Memories with level 50 in both Magic and Prayer to gain either 10,000 Magic or Prayer experience.

achievements.name: Azdaran Birthright
achievements.desc: Complete the Azdaran document.
achievements.tip: Complete the Azdaran document by mining the statues in the Ancient Keldagrim ruins and receiving ten fragments after Birthright of the Dwarves.

achievements.name: Bandos's Memories
achievements.desc: Recover all 14 of Bandos's memories on Yu'biusk.
achievements.tip: Fill Bandos's Memories by collecting an additional 13 Bandos chronicles after The Mighty Fall.

achievements.name: Bandosian Expert
achievements.desc: Restored a collection of Bandosian artefacts.
achievements.tip: Have restored at least one of each artefact from the Warforge Dig Site. There are a total of 27 artefacts.

achievements.name: Bane Tuner
achievements.desc: Unlock the spell: Tune Bane.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Tune Bane spell during or after Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

achievements.name: Banking History
achievements.desc: Find all hidden treasure from the 'Making History' quest.
achievements.tip: Find all hidden treasure from the Meeting History quest. The achievement simply tracks progress towards treasures found from the Meeting History quest.

achievements.name: Behemoth Notes
achievements.desc: Find all Behemoth notes.
achievements.tip: Collect all five Behemoth notes within Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Bill & Ben's Egg/Salon Joint Venture
achievements.desc: After Extinction quest, 'eggs'plore Prehistoric Potterington's (sunny)-side-(up) hustle.
achievements.tip: Complete the six achievements listed below, which may be completed around Anachronia dinosaur farm after completion of the Extinction quest.

achievements.name: Birds of Prey
achievements.desc: Track all of the owls for Deryn.
achievements.tip: Find all 14 owls in the City of Um for Deryn. Completion of the achievement rewards the player with the [Name], Friend of the Owls title, and is a requirement for Master Quest Cape.

achievements.name: Blinded by Ramarno's Teaching
achievements.desc: Claim Smithing XP from Ramarno after 'Defender of Varrock'.
achievements.tip: Give Ramarno a redberry pie during or after Defender of Varrock in order to claim the post-quest 1,000 smithing experience reward. Ramarno can be found by the Sacred Forge, found by entering the hole by the white tree at the top of Ice Mountain. A light source is recommended to avoid taking damage. Contrary to the description, this achievement can be unlocked during the quest.

achievements.name: Bloodstained Treasure
achievements.desc: Obtain hidden runes from Meiyerditch laboratory and blood altar ruins.
achievements.tip: Obtain hidden runes from Meiyerditch laboratory and the blood altar ruins after Legacy of Seergaze.

achievements.name: Bogolin Dichromacy
achievements.desc: Help the bogolins to reach an accord.
achievements.tip: Help the bogolins reach an accord.

achievements.name: Bridge over Fremmy Waters
achievements.desc: Complete all the unabridged Fremennik Sagas.
achievements.tip: Finish all five unabridged Fremennik Sagas.

achievements.name: Brothers Gower
achievements.desc: Claim the rewards from all three Gower brothers after 'Gower Quest'.
achievements.tip: Claim all three lamps from the Gower brothers after completion of Gower Quest. They can be found at the Life altar. Players can get to the altar quickly via the disk of returning whilst standing in any bank area.

achievements.name: Brutal Stuffsies
achievements.desc: Open Uglug's Stuffsies store by selling him Relicym's balm.
achievements.tip: Open Uglug's Stuffsies by giving Uglug Nar a Relicym's balm.

achievements.name: Bugs in the Walls
achievements.desc: Find and read the High Priest of Scabaras' notes.
achievements.tip: Read Priest's Notes, a drop from Elite Profane Scabarites.

achievements.name: Buy and Sell Some XP
achievements.desc: Claim Thieving XP after 'Buyers and Cellars'.
achievements.tip: Pickpocket the training dummy again after asking Darren Lightfinger to do so, earning a total of 2,000 experience. This experience is doubled during Double XP Live events.

achievements.name: Buying Up Ancient Artefacts
achievements.desc: Buy an ancient staff after 'Desert Treasure'.
achievements.tip: Buy an ancient staff from Eblis after completion of the Desert Treasure quest for 80,000 coins.

achievements.name: Carnillean Riches
achievements.desc: Return Lady Henryeta's necklace or open Ceril's money pouch after 'Carnillean Rising'.
achievements.tip: Return Lady Henryeta's necklace or open Sir Ceril's money pouch after the Carnillean Rising quest.

achievements.name: Castaways of the Arc
achievements.desc: Discover all the Arc castaways.
achievements.tip: Talk to each of the castaways.

achievements.name: Caving into the Gains
achievements.desc: Claim the XP from cave paintings and 5,000 coins from Explorer Jack.
achievements.tip: Claim the experience (Crafting, Agility and Woodcutting) from the cave paintings after the Myths of the White Lands quest and claim 5,000 coins from Explorer Jack in the Land of Snow after the quest. Explorer Jack will also give the player 5,000 coins if spoken to from Lumbridge, just north of the castle.

achievements.name: Cecilia, I'm Begging You, Please...
achievements.desc: Tell Sister Cecilia whether to leave or stay after 'One Piercing Note'.
achievements.tip: Tell Sister Cecilia whether to leave or stay after the One Piercing Note quest. She can be found in the Abbey, next to the choir.

achievements.name: Centaur of Attention
achievements.desc: Read the book acquired from Roberta outside the Everlight porcelain clay mine.
achievements.tip: Read the book On the Origin of Centaurs given by Roberta at the Everlight porcelain clay mine after giving her 100 porcelain clay (or 100 soft porcelain clay). Soft porcelain clay is recommended as it is easier to obtain (2 are mined at once from the rocks next to the water stream, rather than 1). One hundred porcelain clay will need to be in the backpack at once to complete the trade. It cannot be handed in in stages, so some noted clay will be required.

achievements.name: Challenge Maria
achievements.desc: Complete Maria's additional challenges and unlock all chests in the Gulvas mansion.
achievements.tip: Collect all nine replay bonus lamps and complete all three challenges in the haunted house after Broken Home.

achievements.name: Challenging Chat
achievements.desc: Hear Vorago's introduction dialogue.
achievements.tip: Listen to Vorago's introduction by talking to him inside of the Borehole lobby and choosing the chat option "Can I face you?". ( 2•2)…

achievements.name: Chilling with Arrav
achievements.desc: Put Arrav (north-east of the mahjarrat ritual marker) to rest after 'Ritual of the Mahjarrat'.
achievements.tip: Put Arrav to rest after the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest. He can be found at the burial site, directly north of the tunnel, north east of the Ritual marker. His body is laying in the snow along the wall of the Ice Fortress. Doing so will award the player with 3,000 Prayer XP.

achievements.name: Chippy Transport
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to chip teleport tablets to Trollheim.
achievements.tip: Unlock the ability to make Trollheim tablets by giving the miner's diary, obtained from Runvastr, to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village after completion of Love Story.

achievements.name: Chivalry is Dead
achievements.desc: Claim the post-quest rewards from 'The Death of Chivalry'.
achievements.tip: Use the two experience lamps claimed from the coffins, loot the supply crate in the Tomb of the Fallen, and kick the gilded cabbage thirty times, after completion of The Death of Chivalry. The supply crate can be found just south of the portal after you enter the tomb, next to the tents.

achievements.name: Chivalry is Fed
achievements.desc: Restore the cabbage patch after 'The Death of Chivalry'.
achievements.tip: Restore the cabbage patch at the north side of Edgeville Monastery after The Death of Chivalry quest. In order to do this, 12 cabbage seeds need to be in the player's inventory and used on the scorch marks in the patch. This will cause a short cutscene to play where the patch is restored and the achievement is completed.

achievements.name: Chivalry is Threads
achievements.desc: Unlock Templar and Dulcin armour after 'The Death of Chivalry'.
achievements.tip: Claim the Templar armour from one of the coffins in the Tomb of the Fallen and the Dulcin armour from defeating Dawn after The Death of Chivalry.

achievements.name: Circus of Fire
achievements.desc: Unlock the firemaker's outfit from the circus.
achievements.tip: Obtain the firemaker's costume from completing any act in Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion after completion of The Firemaker's Curse.

achievements.name: Claiming Azzanadra's Heart
achievements.desc: Claim the medium XP lamp from Azzanadra after 'Heart of Stone'.
achievements.tip: Speak to Azzanadra after completion of Heart of Stone in order to claim a medium experience lamp.

achievements.name: Claiming the Knight's Experience
achievements.desc: Claim the smithing lamp from Squire Asrol after 'Knight's Sword'.
achievements.tip: Use the Smithing XP lamp from Squire Asrol after completing the quest, The Knight's Sword.

achievements.name: Claus is Rising
achievements.desc: Claim a reward from Claus after doing him a favour.
achievements.tip: Hand in a cave wolf matriarch skull to Claus the chef after completion of Carnillean Rising. Players can obtain another skull after the quest by speaking with Claus the chef to re-enter the ominous portal and fight the cave wolf again. Players can choose between these selected rewards:

achievements.name: Clue's in the Monkey Drool
achievements.desc: Receive the medium clue scroll from a monkey in your backpack.
achievements.tip: Receive the sealed medium clue scroll from the monkey in the player's backpack during or after the Monkey Madness quest, after feeding it a number of bananas. The monkey is obtained from saving an unattackable monkey from the Ardougne Zoo.

achievements.name: Collection of Zamorakian Notes
achievements.desc: Find all 5 Zamorakian notes, dropped by those dedicated to Zamorak.
achievements.tip: Find all five Zamorakian notes obtained as drops from certain monsters (each with 1/25 drop rate). The notes are always automatically picked up when received as a drop.

achievements.name: Complete History of Droalak
achievements.desc: Free Droalak after 'Making History'.
achievements.tip: Free Droalak after the Making History quest. He stands behind the General Store in Port Phasmatys and can be set free by simply completing the dialogue with him after the quest, requiring a ghostspeak amulet or the Hard Morytania achievements completed. Once he knows you delivered the scroll to his wife, he is free to depart.

achievements.name: Complete Trekky
achievements.desc: Fully level up all Temple Trekking companions.
achievements.tip: Level all adventurers in Temple Trekking to level 99.

achievements.name: Cook's Delights
achievements.desc: Claim the cook's extra rewards after 'Cook's Assistant'.
achievements.tip: Complete the Cook's Assistant quest, or talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle, if the player has completed the quest before the 3 sardines and 500 coins were added as a reward.

achievements.name: Count All Light Fingers
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the Thieves' Guild.
achievements.tip: Complete the Thieves' Guild miniquests after completion of Buyers and Cellars.

achievements.name: Cower Behind the Chosen Commander
achievements.desc: Claim the goblin cower shield.
achievements.tip: Obtain the goblin cower shield by talking to General Wartface or General Bentnoze after The Chosen Commander. It can still be claimed by non-members, provided they have completed the quest.

achievements.name: Cran Door's Secret
achievements.desc: Unlocked the secret door between Crandor and Karamja.
achievements.tip: Open the wall in Elvarg's lair from the Crandor side during or after Dragon Slayer.

achievements.name: Culinary Exchange
achievements.desc: Deliver a serving of tangled toad's legs to Longramble during or after 'The Path of Glouphrie'.
achievements.tip: Deliver a serving of Tangled toads' legs to Longramble during or after The Path of Glouphrie quest. Giving him a premade ttl does not work.

achievements.name: Curses!
achievements.desc: Unlock the ancient curses by reading the ancient hymnal given to you by Azzanadra.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Ancient Curses by completing The Temple at Senntisten quest.

achievements.name: Daemonology of Celerity
achievements.desc: Claim the malleus daemoniorum.
achievements.tip: Claim the Malleus daemoniorum by talking to Brother Celerity in the Edgeville Monastery after taking part in a Demon Flash Mob.

achievements.name: Daero Take This Experience?
achievements.desc: Claim the XP reward from Daero following Monkey Madness.
achievements.tip: Claim the total of 110,000 combat experience from Daero after completion of the Monkey Madness quest.

achievements.name: Dark Reading Material
achievements.desc: Collect the following 'lore' books from the Infernal Source.
achievements.tip: Collect the following 'lore' books from the Infernal Source Dig Site.

achievements.name: Data Recovery
achievements.desc: Help the Archivist recover all core memory data in the Hall of Memories.
achievements.tip: Help the Archivist recover all core memory data in the Hall of Memories.

achievements.name: Deadlier Catch
achievements.desc: Hunt the Thalassus until it flees for good.
achievements.tip: Hunt the Thalassus another ten times after completion of Deadliest Catch. To begin these hunts, talk to Jones outside the bank in the Fishing Guild.

achievements.name: Death to the Mahjarrat
achievements.desc: Discover all the mahjarrat deathstones on Freneskae.
achievements.tip: Find and inspect all mahjarrat deathstones in Freneskae during or after Children of Mah.

achievements.name: Deep and Bloody Experience
achievements.desc: Claim the XP reward after 'Blood Runs Deep'.
achievements.tip: Claim the 3x 150,000 combat experience reward after Blood Runs Deep by talking to Brundt the Chieftain and selecting option 2 'Ask about the war against the daggermouths.' Repeat this 2 more times to get each lamp.

achievements.name: Diamonds in the Dung
achievements.desc: Find Uraeus and Aten in the Kalphite Nursery after 'Diamond in the Rough'.
achievements.tip: Find Uraeus (Apep's axe) and Aten (Heru's shield) in the Kalphite Nursery after the Diamond in the Rough quest.

achievements.name: Diaries of the Clans
achievements.desc: Find the clan journal pages from the Hefin Agility Course in Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Completely fill the Voice of the Elders by running laps on the Hefin Agility Course. One page is received every 20 laps, and a total of eight are needed to complete the book. Which page you get after every set of 20 laps is randomly determined.

achievements.name: Diary of Oreb
achievements.desc: Discover and read all five journals of The Magister.
achievements.tip: Read all of the The Magister's Journals. The journals can be found as drops from the Magister and the monsters in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.

achievements.name: Diary of the Gods
achievements.desc: Find all five God Wars journals.
achievements.tip: Pick up Zilyana's Notes, The Glory of General Graardor, Armadyl's Assault, Razulei's Tale, and Nex's Followers as drops from the respective bosses in the God Wars Dungeon. The books do not appear in the area loot interface because it generates as a piece of scenery that must be interacted with to collect.

achievements.name: Dishonourable Gains
achievements.desc: Claim all XP chests during or after 'Dishonour among Thieves'.
achievements.tip: Open the three chests in Zamorak's hideout during or after Dishonour among Thieves.

achievements.name: Dishonourable Loot
achievements.desc: Claim all loot chests after 'Dishonour among Thieves'.
achievements.tip: Open five of the six chests that are found along the way during Dishonour among Thieves. The chest in Jerrod's cell does not count as it was initially inaccessible after the completion of the quest.

achievements.name: Distorted Div
achievements.desc: Claim the one-time Divination XP from a distorted engrammeter.
achievements.tip: Claim the one-time Divination XP of 25,000 from a distorted engrammeter.

achievements.name: Divine Ichor
achievements.desc: Find all 7 tablets of 'Divine Ichor'.
achievements.tip: Find all seven tablets of Divine Ichor.

achievements.name: Do a Minion, Take Notes
achievements.desc: Complete the Dominion journal.
achievements.tip: Fill a dominion journal with twenty journal pages, obtained from playing the Dominion Tower.

achievements.name: Do No Elite
achievements.desc: Claim the elite clue scroll using Ava's alerter from 'Do No Evil'.
achievements.tip: Do No Elite is an achievement that requires the player claim the elite clue scroll while using Ava's alerter after completing Do No Evil. There are four possible locations where the elite clue scroll can be found. The clue scroll can be found even if the player has already reached the soft cap.

achievements.name: Don't Fear the Ripper
achievements.desc: Find and read all five miner's journals and the diary of Jebediah Omnis.
achievements.tip: Find and obtain all five miner's journals and The Diary of Jebediah Omnis from Ripper Demons.

achievements.name: Dragon Ink
achievements.desc: Collect the following lore books from bosses inside the Dragonkin Laboratory.
achievements.tip: Obtain the books Diary of an Overzealous Gnome and Redacted Dragonkin Research from Astellarn and Verak Lith, respectively, in the Dragonkin Laboratory.

achievements.name: Dragonkin Diary
achievements.desc: Find and return Naressa's journal to her.
achievements.tip: Find and return Naressa's journal to Naressa in Senntisten, south-west of the Cathedral of Azzanadra. You cannot give the journal to the Naressa in the Effigy Incubator.

achievements.name: Dragonkin Expert
achievements.desc: Restored at least one of each dragonkin artefact.
achievements.tip: Have restored at least one of each dragonkin artefact listed below. There are seven artefacts in Dragonkin I, four artefacts in Dragonkin II and V, five artefacts in Dragonkin III, and six artefacts in Dragonkin IV, VI, and VII.

achievements.name: Dragonkin Logs
achievements.desc: Find and read the adamant dragon journals.
achievements.tip: Find and read all four Dragonkin journals, dropped by adamant dragons in the Dragonkin Lair or the adamant dragon dungeon in Brimhaven Dungeon.

achievements.name: Draugr Me to Hela
achievements.desc: Free the remaining spirits around above-ground Daemonheim after 'Remains of the Necrolord'.
achievements.tip: Free the 14 listless dead wandering in Daemonheim after completion of Remains of the Necrolord.

achievements.name: Dusting Murial
achievements.desc: Update the Dragonkin Primer with murals in Brimhaven Dungeon and Mount Firewake.
achievements.tip: Translate the murals in the adamant dragon dungeon and on Mount Firewake in Kethsi, using a fully charged dragonfire shield of any style whilst the player is holding the Dragonkin Primer in their backpack.

achievements.name: Eastern Adventurer: Eastern Curiosities
achievements.desc: Complete story voyages of the Architect, Chef and Trapper.
achievements.tip: Complete the storylines in the player-owned port for The Architect, The Chef, and The Trapper.

achievements.name: Eastern Adventurer: Guardians of the World
achievements.page: Eastern Adventurer: Guardians of the World
achievements.desc: Complete story voyages of the Tengu, Memory and Exile.
achievements.tip: Complete the storylines in the player-owned port for The Tengu, The Memory, and The Exile.

achievements.name: Eastern Adventurer: Hyu-Ji
achievements.desc: Complete story voyages of the Biologist, Missionary and Convict.
achievements.tip: Complete the storylines in the player-owned port for The Biologist, The Missionary, and The Convict.

achievements.name: Eastern Adventurer: Quin
achievements.desc: Complete story voyages of the Whaler, Occultist and Assassin.
achievements.tip: Complete the storylines in the player-owned port for The Whaler, The Assassin, and The Occultist.

achievements.name: EEEEAGLE!
achievements.desc: Fully unlock all eagle transport routes.
achievements.tip: Fully unlock all of the eagle transport system routes. The routes themselves are unlocked with the completion of Eagles' Peak and Back to my Roots, but two additional actions are required for the achievement (note that rope racks at the eyries do not need to be built to obtain the achievement):

achievements.name: Enough of the Crazy Walking
achievements.desc: Purchase the Mad Ramblings.
achievements.tip: Buy both parts of the Mad Ramblings (The Account of Aesa Fellsdottir (Part 1) and The Account of Aesa Fellsdottir (Part 2)) from Commander Connad for a total of 50 Honour Points in any Barbarian Assault role.

achievements.name: Epi Logueque Experience
achievements.desc: Watch the 'While Guthix Sleeps' epilogue and claim the XP reward.
achievements.tip: Watch the cutscene after While Guthix Sleeps by talking to Idria directly after the quest or Silif at the White Knights' Castle in Falador afterwards. Silif needs to be in the same room as Surok Magis (the room with the cell). Talking to him in another room will not trigger the cutscene.

achievements.name: Experience the Fate of the Gods
achievements.page: Experience the Fate of the Gods
achievements.desc: Claim and use the 'Fate of the Gods' XP lamps from Azzanadra and Wahisietel.

oneOf.text: 80 Attack or 80 Strength or 80 Magic or 80 Ranged or 80 Necromancy or 80 Defence or 80 Constitution

achievements.tip: Claim the three survivor's lamps from Azzanadra (Senntisten temple) and the large prismatic lamp from Wahisietel (Ali the wise, in the northern-most house of Nardah) after Fate of the Gods. The player must select the "Zaros's return" dialogue option.

achievements.name: Explore for Nestor
achievements.desc: Find and read the explorer's notes in the Keldagrim library.
achievements.tip: Obtain the Explorer's notes. The notes can be found on the 1st floor of the Keldagrim Library, which is north of the Palace and west of the bridge.

achievements.name: Family Spirit Tree
achievements.desc: Reconnect the Prifddinas spirit tree with her brethren.
achievements.tip: Plant the spirit tree in Brimhaven, Port Sarim, Etceteria, and Manor Farm before talking to Glouron to claim the Farming XP lamp. The third and fourth trees may only be planted after the first two trees have been health-checked and Glouron has been informed (which also completes Power of Three Spirits).

achievements.name: Fates of the Colossi
achievements.desc: Restore all colossus murals across Havenhythe.
achievements.tip: Fully restore all the murals from the colossi divination activity.

achievements.name: Final Destination Unlocked
achievements.desc: Unlock all ferry points in the City of Um.
achievements.tip: Unlock all of the ferry points within the City of Um by speaking to the ferryman next to each of them.

achievements.name: Finding Tali
achievements.desc: Find Tali and convince her to return home.
achievements.tip: Find Tali and convince her to return home.

achievements.name: Fires are Mostly Harmless
achievements.desc: Light the campfire and find exotic herbs and seeds after 'Fairy Tale III'.

links.name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

achievements.tip: Light the campfire on Mos Le'Harmless (near fairy ring DIP) using 8 willow logs and find the herb cache by searching the mushroom patch in the south-eastern section of the Shredflesh's Cave cave (fairy ring ALP) after completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

achievements.name: Flippers
achievements.desc: Convince Flippers McGraw in the Port Sarim pub to join your crew.
achievements.tip: Convince Flippers McGraw to join their crew.

achievements.name: Fly You Fool
achievements.desc: Convince Velrak the Explorer to escape Taverley Dungeon.
achievements.tip: Convince Velrak the explorer to escape Taverley Dungeon. Kill the jailer for the jail key, then use it on the door. Then, simply speak to him to complete the achievement.

achievements.name: Following In The Footsteps
achievements.desc: Find out the outcome of the research continued by Vicendithas.
achievements.tip: Participate in the Effigy Incubator encounter 12 times and then talk with Vicendithas to find out the outcome of the continued research. Players can use a Distraction & Diversion reset token (monthly) in order to progress the story a second instalment each month. Additionally if the player has completed Extinction, Vicendithas can "accelerate" his research, costing 50,000 Anachronia base camp resources of each type (300,000 total) to unlock each chapter.

achievements.name: For the Love of Mabel
achievements.desc: Return Mabel's ring and chop down the guard's tree.
achievements.tip: Return Mabel's ring to Mabel for Mabel's lamp, and chop down the tree with a guard for a reward of 5,000 coins after completion of Love Story.

achievements.name: Forcae's Mettle
achievements.desc: Complete Forcae's journal.
achievements.tip: Complete Forcae's journal by collecting 10 pages that are dropped by adamant and rune dragons.

achievements.name: Fred's Shearings
achievements.desc: Claim 1,940 coins from Fred the Farmer after the 'Sheep Shearer' miniquest.
achievements.tip: Complete the Sheep Shearer miniquest, then talk to Fred the Farmer to receive an extra 1,940 coins.

achievements.name: Free Beer Here
achievements.desc: Tell Faisal the Barman that Traitorous Hesham's drink was poisoned.
achievements.tip: Tell Faisal the Barman at The Asp & Snake Bar in Pollnivneach that Traitorous Hesham's drink was poisoned.

achievements.name: Friend of the Imcando
achievements.desc: Engage in all of Thalmund's conversations.
achievements.tip: Speak with Thalmund on seven different weeks. Thalmund appears in the City of Um just south of the smithy every Wednesday. It is not necessary to finish the dialogue with Thalmund in order to make progress towards this achievement.

achievements.name: Gift from Sliske
achievements.desc: Unlock Sliske's gift and the sixth-age circuit upgrade.
achievements.tip: Find Sliske at the Empyrean Citadel to get the permanent effect of the ring of visibility, and bring the Sixth-Age circuit to the Guthixian High Druid to add the teleport to the World Gate to the ring after completion of Fate of the Gods.

achievements.name: Gift of Buggies
achievements.desc: Give Aurora her favourite mush.
achievements.tip: Use one buggy mush on Aurora.

achievements.name: God Wars
achievements.desc: Visit an ancient war, which became unfrozen after hundreds of years.
achievements.tip: Enter the God Wars Dungeon.

achievements.name: Goebie One with the Wildlife
achievements.desc: Complete Arod's wildlife reserve on Mazcab.
achievements.tip: Complete Arod's wildlife reserve on Mazcab.

achievements.name: Goebie Relics
achievements.desc: Find all Mazcab stone fragments and take them to the ancient statue.
achievements.tip: Find all five stone fragments scattered around Mazcab and hand them in at the ancient statue at the southern part of the Goebie graveyard.

achievements.name: Got a Vyre Reputation
achievements.desc: Unlock the Vyrelord/Vyrelady title and reach maximum vyre reputation in Darkmeyer.
achievements.tip: Complete all tasks in Darkmeyer to achieve maximum reputation and unlock the Vyrelord/Vyrelady title during or after The Branches of Darkmeyer quest.

achievements.name: Goulash! Get Your Free Goulash!
achievements.desc: Drink 10 bowls of goulash after 'Swept Away'.
achievements.tip: Drink 10 bowls of goulash after the Swept Away quest.

achievements.name: Grave Records
achievements.desc: Collect all 11 pages of the 'Grave Records' in the Sanctum of Rebirth.
achievements.tip: Inspect all 11 crumbling pages of the Grave Records in the Sanctum of Rebirth. Some pages cannot be obtained without Telekinetic Grab. The location for each page can be found here.

achievements.name: Grondaban's Legacy
achievements.desc: Obtain Grondaban's stalker notes from the stalker dungeon.
achievements.tip: Pick up the Grondaban's stalker notes lore book near the portal in the north of the stalker dungeon.

achievements.name: Gunning for Jewellery
achievements.desc: Engrave all of Dororan's jewellery.
achievements.tip: Engrave all of Dororan's jewellery after the completion of Gunnar's Ground.

achievements.name: Guthix and the Chamber of Secrets
achievements.page: Guthix and the Chamber of Secrets
achievements.desc: Learn about Guthix's core memories in the Hall of Memories.
achievements.tip: Learn about Guthix's core memories in the Hall of Memories.

achievements.name: Guthixian Expert
achievements.desc: Restored at least one of each guthixian[sic] artefact.
achievements.tip: Have restored at least one of each Guthixian artefact from the Moonrise Dig Site.

achievements.name: Haul Comes to Templeton
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to trade noted artefacts with Simon Templeton.
achievements.tip: Complete a job for Simon Templeton to unlock the ability to trade noted artefacts.

achievements.name: Heavy Metal
achievements.desc: Obtain all the entries of Boric's Book of Metal by mining the listed ores or catalysts.
achievements.tip: Read Boric's Book of Metal after having found all eight entries of it by mining the listed rocks. The primal ores need to be mined outside the Daemonheim dungeons.

achievements.name: Hello, I Like Money
achievements.desc: Claim 1000 coins from Hannah after solving her crab problem.
achievements.tip: Claim 1,000 coins from grocer Hannah after solving her crab problem.

achievements.name: Herbi's Flax
achievements.desc: Give Herbi Flax's diary to the Varrock apothecary.
achievements.tip: Give Herbi Flax's diary to the Varrock apothecary.

achievements.name: Here Was a Scabaras Mask
achievements.desc: Gain access to the secret treasure room from 'Diamond in the Rough'.
achievements.tip: Mine a crack in the room under the quicksand encountered during Diamond in the Rough to gain access to a treasure room containing the Scabaras mask and the Was.

achievements.name: Heroes of the Graveyard
achievements.desc: Find and read all four books about the heroes buried in Senntisten graveyard.

oneOf.text: 88 Fishing or 88 Hunter or 88 Mining or 88 Woodcutting

achievements.tip: Find and read all four books about the heroes buried in Senntisten graveyard.

achievements.name: History of Bilrach
achievements.desc: Find all Chronicles of Bilrach.
achievements.tip: Collect all thirty Chronicles of Bilrach (also known as mysterious chronicles) in Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Home is Where the God is
achievements.page: Home is Where the God is
achievements.desc: Convince Armadyl to visit Stormguard.
achievements.tip: Convince Armadyl to visit the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.

achievements.name: I Can See For Miles and Miles
achievements.page: I Can See For Miles and Miles
achievements.desc: Unlock all beacon keepers and fully unlock the beacon map.
achievements.tip: Unlock all beacon keepers and fully unlock the beacon map by providing the keepers with macaw pouches.

achievements.name: I Dig This Transportation
achievements.desc: Unlock Dig Site pendants.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Dig Site pendant by cleaning uncleaned finds in the Varrock Museum until they find a clean necklace, and then talk to one of the archaeologists.

achievements.name: I Know. I Was There...
achievements.desc: Obtain personal stories from Edgeville regarding the destruction after 'The Ritual of the Mahjarrat'.
achievements.tip: Collect books from Bruce and from inspecting the furnace in Edgeville.

achievements.name: I Presume These Rewards Are Mine, Death?
achievements.page: I Presume These Rewards Are Mine, Death?
achievements.desc: Claim all rewards from the statue of Death after 'Missing, Presumed Death'.
achievements.tip: Claim all post-quest rewards from the Missing, Presumed Death quest by speaking to the statue of Death, located in the Empyrean Citadel, which can only be reached by using the invitation box.

achievements.name: I Want a New Duck
achievements.desc: Fish for all of the peas in Paddlington after 'Duck Quest'.
achievements.tip: Fish all peas from the three fishing spots around the pond in Paddlington after completing the Duck Quest.

achievements.name: I'm Forever Washing Shadows
achievements.desc: Aid Lord Amlodd in cleansing shadow cores.
achievements.tip: Obtain the 50,000 Divination XP lamp by speaking to Lord Amlodd after cleansing 15 each of truthful, blissful, and manifest shadow cores obtained from the appropriate shadow creatures.

achievements.name: I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)
achievements.page: I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)
achievements.desc: Complete all miniquests listed in the Quests interface. Does not include sagas.
achievements.tip: Complete the listed miniquests.

achievements.name: Ice Ice Chimpy
achievements.desc: Complete 25 chimp ice deliveries.
achievements.tip: Complete an additional 25 chimp ice deliveries, buying them from the chimp ice chimp in the monkey colony in the Kharidian Desert and delivering them to Awowogei on Ape Atoll. See the relevant section of the article for tips and tricks.

achievements.name: Icthlarin's Little Chest
achievements.desc: Loot the chest from the pyramid during or after 'Icthlarin's Little Helper'.
achievements.tip: Loot the chest in Klenter's Pyramid for 50 coins during or after Icthlarin's Little Helper.

achievements.name: Impressing Char
achievements.desc: Create Char's most treasured symbol in her training cave.
achievements.tip: Make a Zaros symbol during an instance of Char's training cave.

achievements.name: Is He Chipped?
achievements.desc: Return Bob's collar to him during or after 'Ritual of the Mahjarrat'.
achievements.tip: Return Bob's collar to him during or after the Ritual of the Mahjarrat quest.

achievements.name: It's Like God Book Illuminations in Here
achievements.page: It's Like God Book Illuminations in Here
achievements.desc: Create all 6 illuminated God Books after 'One Piercing Note'.
achievements.tip: Create all 6 illuminated god books after the One Piercing Note quest.

achievements.name: Ivan is Flailing
achievements.desc: Unlock the full power of the ivandis flail by burning vyre corpses in the Columbarium.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the Ivandis flail by burning 500 vyre corpses in the Columbarium. Kills completed by using Sunspear or any of its reformed versions do not count towards the total.

achievements.name: Jas not Meant for Mortal Hands
achievements.page: Jas not Meant for Mortal Hands
achievements.desc: Return to the Submerged Statue at Entrana after 'One of a Kind' and 'Ritual of the Mahjarrat'.
achievements.tip: Return to the Submerged Statue at Entrana after the One of a Kind and Ritual of the Mahjarrat quests. This grants the player 25,000 bonus experience in a skill of their choosing.

achievements.name: Kaiki's Tusks
achievements.desc: Complete Kaigi's journal.
achievements.tip: Obtain Kaigi's journal as well as four Kaigi's journal pages as drops from airut.

achievements.name: Kal'gerion Notes
achievements.desc: Find all Kal'gerion notes.
achievements.tip: Collect all five parts of the Kal'gerion notes within Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Keeping Up with the Carnilleans
achievements.desc: Claim and use 8 experience lamps from Philipe Carnillean.
achievements.tip: Find Philipe Carnillean around Gielinor and claim the first 8 experience lamps from him. See adventures of his own on his page for a complete list. You can speak to Ceril Carnillean to find out more about Philipe's current location. This is required for him to be at the first location, but optional for all following locations.

achievements.name: Koschei's Cache
achievements.desc: Complete the 'Koschei's Troubles' miniquest and unlock all jewel memories.
achievements.tip: Complete the Koschei's Troubles miniquest and speak to Koschei with all three different jewel colours (blue, green, and red).

achievements.name: Kudos to You
achievements.desc: Reach full Kudos with the Varrock Museum.
achievements.tip: Obtain all available Kudos by helping out the Varrock Museum. To check remaining Kudos points to gain, speak with the information clerk in the north west corner of the museum.

achievements.name: Lamp of Luxury
achievements.desc: Rub these quest lamps that can be reclaimed from May's storage chest, near Varrock lodestone.
achievements.tip: Rub the lamps that can be reclaimed from May's Storage Chest.

achievements.name: Last of the Summer Swine
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the pig creation machine after 'Bringing Home the Bacon'.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the pig creation machine (pack pig machine, prayer pig machine, or war pig machine) in the underground pig pens at the Falador farm after the Bringing Home the Bacon quest. After upgrading, the achievement might not be awarded until changing the machine type. Planks are not automatically used out of a plank box. Players are required to remove needed planks to use them.

achievements.name: Learning from Mr Mordaut
achievements.desc: Claim and use the Divination XP lamp from Mr. Mordaut after 'One of a Kind'.
achievements.tip: Claim and use the Divination lamp from Mr Mordaut after the One of a Kind quest.

achievements.name: Legal Entitlement
achievements.desc: Inform the Old man about the fate of his mother after 'Vessel of the Harbinger'.
achievements.tip: Talk to the old man after the completion of Vessel of the Harbinger. He is located on the shipwreck north of Alice's farm in Morytania.

achievements.name: Let Us Give Ugthanks
achievements.desc: Find and read the Ugthanatos journal.
achievements.tip: Read the Ugthanatos journal. This can be obtained without a Slayer assignment of camel warriors and with a temporary boost.

achievements.name: Let's Hope it Doesn't Un-Shrink
achievements.desc: Claim the King Slime's Top Hat cosmetic override from Eva after 'Once Upon a Slime'.
achievements.tip: Claim the King Slime's Top Hat cosmetic override from Eva after the Once Upon a Slime quest. She can be found just south of Varrock east bank, in the house with the Shrinking Machine and anvil.

achievements.name: Library of Nex
achievements.desc: Find and read the books from the Nex, Angel of Death encounter.
achievements.tip: Obtain The Promised Gift and The Praesul by completing one Nex, Angel of Death encounter.

achievements.name: Load of Bakulla
achievements.desc: Hear the Epic of Bukalla in the Rellekka longhall.
achievements.tip: Hear the Epic of Bukalla in the Rellekka Long Hall Bar after the quest The Fremennik Trials.

achievements.name: Looting the Demon Throne
achievements.desc: Claim the gems from the demon throne during or after 'The Golem'.
achievements.tip: Extract the gems from the throne in Thammaron's Throne Room, during or after The Golem quest, by using a chisel. This will yield 2 rubies, 2 emeralds, and 2 sapphires.

achievements.name: Lost and...Found?
achievements.desc: Discover the hidden places in Moonsylvar Wood.
achievements.tip: Discover 5 hidden places in Moonsylvar Wood. Each special location can be accessed by following the forest's patterns to get closer to it.

achievements.name: Lovingly Crafted
achievements.desc: Discover and read all five Horror journals.
achievements.tip: Obtain and read all five horror journals. The blasphemous journal has to be obtained last.

achievements.name: Lurgon's Run
achievements.desc: Unlock the Dorgesh-Kaan food trading minigame.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Dorgesh-Kaan food trading minigame.

achievements.name: Madness and Malediction
achievements.desc: Find and read 'Archaeology Journal - H.F.A', found in the Zamorakian Undercity.
achievements.tip: Find and read Archaeology Journal - H.F.A, found in The Zamorakian Undercity when the player attacks the Berserk Archaeologist who will throw the journal at the player. This achievement can be completed in story mode.

achievements.name: Mage Arena
achievements.desc: Defeat Kolodion at the Mage Arena and collect a god staff.
achievements.tip: Defeat Kolodion at the Mage Arena and collect a god staff.

achievements.name: Make Them Bleed
achievements.desc: Perform well enough in Rush of Blood to impress Morvran.
achievements.tip: Clear wave 20 of any difficulty of Rush of Blood, then claim the Slayer XP lamp from Morvran by talking to him either inside or outside the arena.

achievements.name: Many Shades of a Cure
achievements.desc: Permanently cure Razmire and Ulsquire after 'Shades of Mort'ton'.
achievements.tip: Use a dose of Serum 208 on Razmire Keelgan and Ulsquire Shauncy. Despite the description, it does not actually require completion of Shades of Mort'ton.

achievements.name: Marmaros and Thok Letters
achievements.desc: Find all Marmaros and Thok letters from Daemonheim.
achievements.tip: Collect all ten M. and thok letters within Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Mask of Dragith Nurn
achievements.desc: Assemble the five parts of the Mask of Dragith Nurn from the Lumbridge Catacombs.
achievements.tip: Assemble the five parts of the Mask of Dragith Nurn from the Lumbridge Catacombs which rewards the cosmetic override of the mask as well as the mask as an item.

achievements.name: Master Bogreman
achievements.desc: Unlock the ogre bowman hat by killing 30 chompy birds.
achievements.tip: Unlock the ogre bowman hat by killing 30 chompy birds.

achievements.name: Maya Use Your Fish Farm?
achievements.desc: Learn how to use the Wendlewick fish farm.
achievements.tip: Learn how to use the Wendlewick Fish Farm.

achievements.name: Measure of Old
achievements.desc: Use the Measure to find the four Elder God chronicles.
achievements.tip: Place The Measure to locate and interact with the four elder chronicles after completion of Fate of the Gods. Completion of this achievement will reward the player with a total of 200,000 experience.

achievements.name: Meeting your Idols
achievements.desc: Investigate an overgrown Karamjan idol to discover an ancient tale.
achievements.tip: Find the book titled The End of Gara-Dul. It is found by investigating a cleared overgrown idol on Karamja. The idol remains cleared for about 2 minutes and 24 seconds before the vines grow back.

achievements.name: Memoirs of the Devourer
achievements.desc: Read the Memoirs of the Devourer from Amascut, the Devourer.
achievements.tip: Memoirs of the Devourer is an achievement awarded for reading Memoirs of the Devourer, a lore book dropped by Amascut, the Devourer.

achievements.name: Memories of Guthix
achievements.desc: Attune and hand all engrams in to the Memorial to Guthix.
achievements.tip: Complete the Memorial to Guthix at least once by collecting all engrams, charging them, and handing them in to Orla Fairweather. Players need to complete the tutorial with Orla Fairweather first in order to be able to pick up the engrams.

achievements.name: Message from the Abyss
achievements.desc: Find and read 'Scions of Erebus', dropped by an Abyssal lord.
achievements.tip: Obtain and read the book Scions of Erebus, which is dropped by abyssal lords.

achievements.name: Met Het Yet?
achievements.desc: Gain access to the secret treasure room from 'Our Man in the North'.
achievements.tip: Access the secret tomb found in Het's Oasis after Our Man in the North.

achievements.name: Milk of Chocolate, Snape of Grass
achievements.page: Milk of Chocolate, Snape of Grass
achievements.desc: Sober up Skippy.
achievements.tip: Sober up Skippy with a bucket of water, nettle tea, and a hangover cure on him. The player first needs to talk to Skippy to learn that he needs sobering up. After this, the player should right-click him with a bucket of water in their inventory and click the sober-up option. This will only work if Skippy has come to a standstill. Afterwards, the player will need to speak to him while carrying nettle tea in order to give it to him. Finally, the player will need to speak to him a third time while carrying the hangover cure in order to cure his hangover completely.

achievements.name: Milky Teeth
achievements.desc: Give the Tooth Fairy five teeth and claim a tooth creature pet.

links.name: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

achievements.tip: Claim the tooth creature pet from the Tooth Fairy by giving her a variety of teeth. Teeth which are sold to the tooth fairy rather than given to her do not count towards this achievement.

achievements.name: Miniature Monolith Maestro
achievements.desc: Create the cosmic accumulator by combining the cosmic focus and the cosmic pyramid after 'Desperate Measures'.
achievements.tip: Create the cosmic accumulator by combining the cosmic focus and the cosmic pyramid after the Desperate Measures quest.

achievements.name: Miscellaneous Notes
achievements.desc: Find Misc. Dungeoneering journals 1 through 15.
achievements.tip: Collect the first fifteen Miscellaneous journals within Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Mixing in Ancient Circles
achievements.desc: Restore the fairy ring in the Ancient Cavern.

links.name: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

achievements.tip: Restore the fairy ring in the Ancient Cavern by planting 5 bittercap mushrooms.

achievements.name: My Adze is Bigger Than Yours
achievements.page: My Adze is Bigger Than Yours
achievements.desc: Speak to King Roald with the inferno adze equipped.
achievements.tip: Speak to King Roald with the inferno adze equipped.

achievements.name: My Precious!
achievements.desc: Find and return Gregg 'Groggy' Herring's lost ring.
achievements.tip: Return Gregg 'groggy' herring's ring to Gregg 'Groggy' Herring.

achievements.name: Myreque in Memoriam
achievements.desc: Complete construction of the Myreque memorial and help Veliaf to move on.
achievements.tip: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz after the completion of the In Memory of the Myreque miniquest and the River of Blood quest.

achievements.desc: Complete all the Daemonheim mysteries.
achievements.tip: Complete all mysteries at the Daemonheim Dig Site.

achievements.desc: Complete all the Everlight mysteries.
achievements.tip: Solve all mysteries at the Everlight Dig Site.

achievements.desc: Complete all the Guild mysteries.
achievements.tip: Have completed the mysteries Secrets of the Monolith and Writings on the Walls.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Infernal Source
achievements.desc: Complete all the Infernal Source mysteries.
achievements.tip: Complete all mysteries at the Infernal Source Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Kharid-et
achievements.desc: Complete all the Kharid-et mysteries.
achievements.tip: Solve all mysteries at the Kharid-et Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Moonrise
achievements.desc: Complete all the Moonrise mysteries.

links.name: Inside You There Are Two Wolves

achievements.tip: Solve all mysteries at the Moonrise Dig Site except for A Tangled Web.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Orthen
achievements.desc: Complete all the Orthen mysteries.
achievements.tip: Complete all mysteries at the Orthen Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Senntisten
achievements.desc: Complete all the Daemonheim[sic] mysteries.
achievements.tip: Complete all mysteries at the Senntisten Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Stormguard Citadel
achievements.desc: Complete all the Stormguard mysteries.
achievements.tip: Complete all mysteries at the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries - Warforge
achievements.desc: Complete all the Warforge mysteries.
achievements.tip: Solve all mysteries related to the Warforge Dig Site.

achievements.name: Mysteries of the TokHaar
achievements.desc: Fully interact with the mysterious statues after 'One of a Kind'.
achievements.tip: Have interacted with and rotated all four mysterious statues after speaking with Hannibus during the One of a Kind quest.

achievements.name: Nano to Kipple, Come in Kipple
achievements.page: Nano to Kipple, Come in Kipple
achievements.desc: Claim the Kipple Nano pet.
achievements.tip: Talk to Ariane at the Wizards' Tower, or east thereof, to claim Kipple Nano after completion of Heart of Stone.

achievements.name: Naturally Muspah
achievements.desc: Claim the reward lamp from the natural historian after 'The Tale of the Muspah'.
achievements.tip: Answer the questions of the natural historian northeast of the Rellekka Hunter area after completing The Tale of the Muspah quest. Doing so rewards the player with an antique lamp, which grants 200 experience in any skill above level 10.

achievements.name: New Varrock Set Tasks - Easy
achievements.desc: Given by Tiny Zemouregal in New Varrock square for completing all Easy Tasks in New Varrock.
achievements.tip: New Varrock Set Tasks - Easy is an achievement that is rewarded upon finishing the easy set of the New Varrock achievements.

achievements.name: New Varrock Set Tasks - Elite
achievements.desc: Given by Tiny Zemouregal in New Varrock square for completing all Elite Tasks in New Varrock.
achievements.tip: New Varrock Set Tasks - Elite is an achievement that is rewarded upon finishing the elite set of the New Varrock achievements.

achievements.name: New Varrock Set Tasks - Hard
achievements.desc: Given by Tiny Zemouregal in New Varrock square for completing all Hard Tasks in New Varrock.
achievements.tip: New Varrock Set Tasks - Hard is an achievement that is rewarded upon finishing the hard set of the New Varrock achievements.

achievements.name: New Varrock Set Tasks - Medium
achievements.desc: Given by Tiny Zemouregal in New Varrock square for completing all Medium Tasks in New Varrock.
achievements.tip: New Varrock Set Tasks - Medium is an achievement that is rewarded upon finishing the medium set of the New Varrock achievements.

achievements.name: No Secrets Left to Steal
achievements.desc: Restore and claim from the statues of four famous icyene.
achievements.tip: No Secrets Left to Steal is an achievement that can be unlocked at the Everlight Dig Site by restoring, adding an item to, and opening the four statues found in the dig site.

achievements.name: Now That's What I Call a Dead Parrot
achievements.page: Now That's What I Call a Dead Parrot
achievements.desc: Unlock the Ex-Ex-Parrot pet after 'Rocking Out'.
achievements.tip: Unlock the ex-ex-parrot pet after the Rocking Out quest.

achievements.name: Ocellus Virius Notus
achievements.desc: Complete History of the Order of Ascension.
achievements.tip: Complete the History of the Order book by collecting twenty-two order journal pages from killing monsters inside the Monastery of Ascension.

achievements.name: Of Kraken Ink
achievements.desc: Collect the following lore books from bosses inside the Shadow Reef.
achievements.tip: Collect the lore books, The Last Offering and Kranon's Ancient Journal, from the Crassian Leviathan and Taraket the Necromancer, respectively, inside The Shadow Reef.

achievements.name: On a Mission from...the Gods
achievements.desc: Complete the 'God Emissaries' miniquest.
other: A combined total of 200 levels in Summoning, Magic, Prayer, and Runecrafting
achievements.tip: Complete all of the tasks given by the God Emissaries, and to claim the reward helmet.

achievements.name: One Final Ride
achievements.desc: Find and read the Last Riders book, dropped by the King Black Dragon.
achievements.tip: Read the last riders book. The book can be obtained by killing King Black Dragon.

achievements.name: One Man's Junk...Is Mine
achievements.desc: Fully loot Movario's base.
achievements.tip: Fully loot Movario's base. The room containing all the loot can be accessed by entering a tunnel in Movario's study. Movario's base contains 100 each of coal, death runes, fire runes, and magic logs. Attempting to use magic notepaper on the coal or logs presents the message "You cannot use magic notepaper in this situation."

achievements.name: Ornate Crockery
achievements.desc: Create the big bowl for Tears of Guthix.
achievements.tip: Create the ornate bowl by mining the rocks inside of the magic stone mine and using a chisel on a larger rock, then handing it to Juna. In order to activate the achievement, you must speak to Juna about creating additional bowls. Otherwise you won't be able to mine more rocks. To access the mining area you need to carry a sapphire lantern to be able to travel the light creature located in the cave at Juna.

achievements.name: Otto the Ancient
achievements.desc: Find all barbarian notes in the Ancient Cavern.
achievements.tip: Find all 26 ancient pages from rummaging skeletons and fighting monsters within the Ancient Cavern. See here for a list of pages.

achievements.name: Out into the Ourania
achievements.desc: Unlock the spell: Ourania Teleport.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Ourania Teleport spell by talking to Baba Yaga with the Lunar spellbook active after completion of Lunar Diplomacy.

achievements.name: Out of the Past
achievements.desc: Give Sharrigan her mentor's Pastkeeper Amulet.
achievements.tip: Give Pastkeeper Sharrigan her mentor's Pastkeeper amulet.

achievements.name: Oyster Mash
achievements.desc: Feed the giant oyster on Tutorial Island.
achievements.tip: Feed the Giant Oyster on Tutorial Island.

achievements.name: Paint It Red
achievements.desc: Uncover the secrets of haemalchemy, after 'River of Blood'.
achievements.tip: Uncover the secrets of haemalchemy, after the River of Blood quest.

achievements.name: Pane in the Glass
achievements.desc: Repair the stained glass windows in the Cathedral.
achievements.tip: Repair the four broken stained glass windows in the cathedral in Senntisten.

achievements.name: Penny For Your Life
achievements.desc: Unlock all rewards from 'Dimension of Disaster'.
achievements.tip: Buy all the upgrades and cosmetics from Aris' Reward Shop after Dimension of Disaster (excluding the weekly XP lamp), requiring a total of 30 silver pennies, equivalent to completing the quest and then replaying it four more times. Purchasing the two (permanent, optional) boss skips after quest completion, subsequent playthroughs take approximately 30 minutes. Hence, the optimal strategy from completing the quest is: Agrith Naar, Zemouregal, Zombie, Cultist, Sani & Zaff, (spend 3 pennies on cosmetics), Darklight, and then everything else.

achievements.name: Potion For a Lady
achievements.desc: Help Lady Meilyr to retrieve her lost potion recipes.
achievements.tip: Find one unreadable page in Daemonheim and give Lady Meilyr a self-made super melee potion in exchange for the melee XP lamp.

achievements.name: Potting Is Such Sweet Sorrow
achievements.desc: Help Bill (near the mystical tree on the west coast of Anachronia) realise his 'pot'ential.
achievements.tip: Help Bill—who is located near the mystical tree on the west coast of Anachronia—realise his potential by completing the below steps. Bill will not have any chat options about the magic pot until the achievement Mycomanagement is completed, which involves helping Bill with Eggsperimentation, requiring 95 Firemaking.

achievements.name: Power of Three Spirits
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to grow three spirit trees at once.
achievements.tip: Unlock the ability to grow three spirit trees at once. This ability is unlocked by completing the Plague's End and The Prisoner of Glouphrie quests while also having level 89 Farming by talking with Glouron near the spirit tree in Prifddinas.

achievements.name: Pulling on the Threads
achievements.desc: Discover all of the chapters in 'The Needle Skips' and then claim your reward from Megan.
achievements.tip: Discover all of the memory fragments in each chapter in The Needle Skips and then claim the reward from Megan.

achievements.name: Pure Newbstalgia
achievements.desc: Use Lev's old music box after 'Beneath Cursed Tides'.
achievements.tip: Use Lev's old music box after the Beneath Cursed Tides quest.

achievements.tip: Kill the Queen Black Dragon for all dragonkin journals and also read these journals.

achievements.page: Red Sky All the Time, Shepherds Confused
achievements.desc: Use the Bloodstone to turn the skies red after 'River of Blood'.
achievements.tip: Claim and activate the bloodstone from Vanescula Drakan after the completion of River of Blood.

achievements.name: Redistribution of Knowledge
achievements.desc: Claim Thieving XP from Caelyn Kadaan after 'Heartstealer'.
achievements.tip: Claim the Thieving XP lamp from Caelyn Kadaan after completion of the Heartstealer quest.

achievements.tip: Re-kindle the Dragon forge.

achievements.desc: Claim XP from the Holy Cithara.
achievements.tip: Obtain and play the Holy Cithara. The Holy Cithara is an object that can be found within the holy reliquary in the basement of the Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede after completing One Piercing Note.

achievements.tip: Claim 20 coins from the bartender of the Rusty Anchor after Rocking Out.
