achievements.desc: Restored a collection of Saradominist artefacts.
achievements.tip: Have restored all Saradominist artefacts from the Everlight Dig Site. There are a total of 31 artefacts.

achievements.name: Scabigail
achievements.desc: Complete the Scabaras research and present it to lead archaeologist Abigail.
achievements.tip: Collect all 19 scabarite notes to complete Scabaras research and present it to lead archaeologist Abigail. The notes can only be obtained as drops after talking to lead archaeologist Abigail at Ullek ruins about the research during the quest Dealing with Scabaras.

achievements.name: Scorpvino
achievements.desc: Claim a jug of wine from the Observatory assistant after 'Observatory Quest'.
achievements.tip: Claim a jug of wine from the Observatory assistant after the Observatory Quest.

achievements.name: Scribbling in the Depths
achievements.desc: Obtain the hidden rewards after the 'Song from the Depths' quest.
achievements.tip: Obtain the Constitution experience after completion of the Song from the Depths quest with level 80 Constitution.

achievements.name: Scribblings of a Dragonkin
achievements.desc: Find 'Vicendithas' Scribblings' located in the Edimmu Resource Dungeon.
achievements.tip: Collect Vicendithas' Scribblings inside of the Edimmu resource dungeon. The book is found by searching the Dragonkin altar.

achievements.name: Selene's Lessons
achievements.desc: Find all 9 pages of 'Selene's Lessons' and return the finished book to Raz.
achievements.tip: Find all 9 pages of Selene's Lessons and return the finished book to Raz.

achievements.name: Sentient Letters
achievements.desc: Collect all of the letters from the Senntisten dig.
achievements.tip: Collect the four lore drops (letter signed 'Pontifex Madromurt', letter signed 'Pontifex Nabor', letter signed 'Pontifex Bilrach' and the damaged letter) from activities within the Empty Throne Room. The chance of receiving letters is significantly improved while training on empowered resources.

achievements.name: Seren Memories
achievements.desc: Deposit Seren memoriam crystals (from the Approach of Freneskae), then search the Sanctum alcove.
achievements.tip: Deposit all four of Seren memoriam crystals to the memoriam device and claim the Crest of Seren override from the storage in the Sanctum on Freneskae after the quest Fate of the Gods.

achievements.name: Shadow Hanging Over Me
achievements.desc: Claim all treasure from the chests during 'A Shadow over Ashdale', or talk to Gudrik to claim them afterwards.
achievements.tip: Claim all treasure from the chests during (or from Gudrik after) the A Shadow over Ashdale quest.

achievements.name: Shell-Shocked
achievements.desc: Speak to Edvard in the Abyss after 'Tortle Combat'.
achievements.tip: Speak to Edvard after completion of the Tortle Combat miniquest.

achievements.name: Sing for the Lady
achievements.desc: Help Lady Ithell with crystal singing research.
achievements.tip: Claim the magic XP lamp from Lady Ithell by using the following items on her one at a time: crystal staff, crystal orb, crystal wand and crystal ward. After using an item on her, a crystal weapon seed or a crystal armour seed of the relevant type is immediately given back. Used weapons cannot be provided; the weapons must be at 100% charge. They can be crafted from crystal seeds or purchased from the Grand Exchange. After this exchange occurs, speak with Lady Ithell once more to obtain the lamp and complete the achievement. ( 4)…

achievements.name: Skeletal Wishes
achievements.desc: Help the Odd Old Man complete his creepy tasks.

links.name: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing King Awowogei

achievements.tip: Complete the Rag and Bone Man wish list and the Fur 'n Seek wish list, and then having the Odd Old Man rebuild the skeletal horror. The rebuilding objective can only be completed after the skeletal horror has been defeated once.

achievements.name: Sliske's New Game Plus
achievements.desc: Replay 'Sliske's Endgame' once to receive the 'Agent of the Eldest' cosmetic outfit override.
achievements.tip: Replay Sliske's Endgame once to receive the Agent of the Eldest cosmetic outfit override.

achievements.name: Soft Dragon, Warm Dragon
achievements.desc: Read two bedtime stories to Vorkath.
achievements.tip: Read The Shadow Realm and Zorgoth's Journal to Vorkath in the City of Um.

achievements.name: Some Old Dusty Journals
achievements.desc: Find the Ancient, Dusty and Weathered Tarddian journals.
achievements.tip: Find the Ancient, Dusty, and Weathered Tarddian Journal found on Tarddiad after The Light Within. Players can use High Contrast Mode to highlight the various scenery to search.

achievements.name: Squeal for Coins
achievements.desc: Claim the coins from Yelps' cash bag after fighting him.
achievements.tip: Claim Yelps's very own cash bag from his chest located in the northern tent of the goblin camp in Yu'biusk after killing him. Alternatively, if players spare him during The Mighty Fall, players are required to open the bag which is automatically placed in the player's bank, or destroy the bag and reclaim from the chest.

achievements.name: Stalker Notes
achievements.desc: Find all Stalker notes.
achievements.tip: Collect all five Stalker notes within Daemonheim.

achievements.name: Stay Safe
achievements.desc: Fully complete the Stronghold of Player Safety.
achievements.tip: Obtain the rewards of the chest at the end of the Stronghold of Player Safety. Pull an old lever on the upper floor of the stronghold, then enter the secure area and loot the treasure chest.

achievements.name: Stay Secure
achievements.desc: Fully complete the Stronghold of Security.
achievements.tip: Obtain the rewards from the Gift of Peace, Grain of Plenty, Box of Health and Cradle of Life within the Stronghold of Security.

achievements.name: Stealing Sedridor's Stones
achievements.desc: Fully loot Archmage Sedridor's chest.
achievements.tip: Obtain all of the pure essence from Archmage Sedridor's chest after completing Rune Memories.

achievements.name: Stone Cold Observers
achievements.desc: Observe all the large dragonkin statues around Anachronia.
achievements.tip: Observe all five large dragonkin statues around Anachronia, excluding the statue at the Anachronia base camp.

achievements.name: Summary Spirits
achievements.desc: Claim the XP from all Wilderness spirit realm portals.
achievements.tip: Enter all of the Spirit Realm portals in Wilderness after completing Summer's End. There are 8 in total. Players must be wearing Jennica's ring to activate the portal. None of the skill requirements are boostable.

achievements.name: Supply and Demand
achievements.desc: Complete five supply runs after 'Death Plateau'.
achievements.tip: Complete five supply runs after completion of Death Plateau. If a player has completed the original version of Death Plateau but not the reworked version, Supplies cannot be obtained from Commander Denulth. This is a possible bug.

achievements.name: Tactless Analysis
achievements.desc: Collect all 22 pages of dragonkin research in the Dragonkin Laboratory.
achievements.tip: Inspect all 22 dragonkin research notes to complete dragonkin research in the Dragonkin Laboratory.

achievements.name: Take it to Sir Tiffy in a Jiffy
achievements.page: Take it to Sir Tiffy in a Jiffy
achievements.desc: Deliver the knight's notes from the God Wars Dungeon to Sir Tiffy Cashien.
achievements.tip: Deliver the knight's notes from the God Wars Dungeon to Sir Tiffy Cashien.

achievements.name: Tasty Bobbles
achievements.desc: Unlock the Tim and Crunchy pets during or after 'Gower Quest'.
achievements.tip: Speak with Tim and Crunchy after completing Gower Quest to obtain bobblehead pets of themselves.

achievements.name: That'll Teach Bill
achievements.desc: Claim 10,000 coins from Bill Teach after 'Cabin Fever'.
achievements.tip: Speak to Bill Teach after completion of Cabin Fever in order to claim 10,000 coins from him.

achievements.name: That's a Lot of Books
achievements.desc: Try to enter the Grand Library.
achievements.tip: Enter the Grand Library of Menaphos.

achievements.name: The Book of Elei
achievements.desc: Collect all 22 pages of Elei's Diary in the Temple of Aminishi.
achievements.tip: Obtain all 22 acolyte's diary pages to complete Elei's Diary in the Temple of Aminishi.

achievements.name: The Elder Ring
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the Shadow Pontifex ring.
achievements.tip: The Elder Ring is an achievement that requires a player to upgrade their Pontifex shadow ring to the maximum tier (T6, 1,000 anima of four types) and overcharging it (5,000 anima of four types). This requires the below resonant anima of all elder gods.

achievements.name: The Firemaker's Pet
achievements.desc: Claim a fire creature pet from Char's training cave after 'The Firemaker's Curse'.
achievements.tip: Claim one of the fire creature pets from Char's training cave after The Firemaker's Curse quest.

achievements.name: The History of Slayer
achievements.desc: Uncover all of the murals inside the Sunken Pyramid.
achievements.tip: Read all of the murals in the sunken pyramid. These can be uncovered by collecting 110 unique souls and depositing them into the chest at the centre of the pyramid. Each mural uncovers when the previous mural has been looked at, the dialogue with Faiza has been completed, and when the capture threshold is met for the mural. The number of captured souls can be viewed in the Slayer Codex.

achievements.name: The Journal of Fell Arnessen
achievements.desc: Obtain the Journal of Fell Arnessen from the Arch Glacor.
achievements.tip: Obtain the Journal of Fell Arnessen from the Arch-Glacor.

achievements.name: The Lute of Love
achievements.desc: Craft a lute for Dalia the lumberjack.
achievements.tip: Craft a lute for Dalia the lumberjack.

achievements.name: The Many Hands That Write
achievements.desc: Collect the following lore books from bosses inside the Temple of Aminishi.
achievements.tip: Obtain the books Crassian Allegiance and Himiko's Vision from The Sanctum Guardian and Masuta the Ascended in the Temple of Aminishi.

achievements.name: The Tale of Hawthorn
achievements.desc: Find and read the tale of the founder of Amberfell.
achievements.tip: Find and read the book with the same name, The Tale of Hawthorn.

achievements.name: The Worst Witch's Grimoire
achievements.desc: Find and restore all 22 pages from the burnt grimoire in the Zamorakian Undercity.
achievements.tip: Find and inspect all 22 burnt pages in The Zamorakian Undercity, completing Findings from the Undercity. Some pages cannot be obtained without Telekinetic Grab.

achievements.name: Three's a Kiln
achievements.desc: Claim the enhanced fire cape override from TzHaar-Mej-Jeh, by completing the Fight Kiln once with each of the following combat styles: Melee, Ranged, and Magic.
achievements.tip: Hand in the three original TokHaar-Kal capes to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the Main Plaza of TzHaar City to claim the Enhanced Fire Cape cosmetic override.

achievements.name: Through the Eye of the Needle
achievements.page: Through the Eye of the Needle
achievements.desc: Witness Jas task Kerapac with retrieving her kin.
achievements.tip: Witness Jas task Kerapac with retrieving her kin in Senntisten.

achievements.name: To Dream, Perchance to Keep
achievements.desc: Help Pastkeeper Sharrigan to remember all stories within the 'Dream of Iaia'.
achievements.tip: Help Pastkeeper Sharrigan to remember all six stories within the Dream of Iaia by training at all six skilling stations. Completion of this achievement is required in order to use the 'Amber Haze' and 'Iaia (Surface)' options on the skyboxes and filters interface.

achievements.name: To Thaw a Frozen Heart
achievements.desc: Thaw all the frozen snow implings in Yeti Town after 'Violet is Blue'.
achievements.tip: Find and thaw all four frozen snow implings in Yeti Town. Thawing all four requires level 80 in all non-elite skills (non-boostable). If the player has already completed the Violet is Blue Too quest, the player must select the Violet is Blue version of the town from the portal in order to find the snow implings.

achievements.name: Tome Raider
achievements.desc: Collect the following lore books from bosses inside the Sanctum of Rebirth.
achievements.tip: Collect the following lore books from the Sanctum of Rebirth. The books are only dropped if not already obtained before. Starting from the second kill of the respective boss, the denominator is decreased by one with every kill until the drop becomes guaranteed at 16 kills.

achievements.name: Trader Woes
achievements.desc: Help Nathan the banker set up a trade venture.
achievements.tip: Help Banker Nathan set up a trade venture.

achievements.name: Trials of the Heart
achievements.desc: Claim the Helmet of Trials.
achievements.tip: Claim the helmet of trials.

achievements.name: Trickster's Trinkets
achievements.desc: Discover all the trinkets and restore the old necklace after 'You Are It'.
achievements.tip: Trickster's Trinkets is an achievement which can be completed by finding all necklace trinkets and combining them with the old necklace to create the necklace of Charos after the You Are It quest.

achievements.name: Triple Trouble
achievements.desc: Unlock the post-quest rewards of Tamayu, Tinsay and Tiadeche.
achievements.tip: Claim the rewards from the three brothers after completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. The reward is claimed by speaking to each brother.

achievements.name: Troublesome Crystals
achievements.desc: Find all of the memoriam crystals in Prifddinas.

links.name: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

achievements.tip: Collect all 16 Prifddinas memoriam crystals after Plague's End, not including the unknown crystal. The player then has to deposit the crystals in the Prifddinas memoriam device, located in the Tower of Voices.

achievements.name: Two Rites Don't Make a Wrong
achievements.page: Two Rites Don't Make a Wrong
achievements.desc: Free Klenter's soul during or after 'Icthlarin's Little Helper'.
achievements.tip: Free Klenter's soul during or after the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest.

achievements.name: Ultimate Codex
achievements.desc: Claim and read the Codex Ultimatus.

oneOf.text: 75 Attack or 75 Ranged or 75 Magic or 91 Constitution

achievements.tip: Claim the Codex Ultimatus from the archaeological expert and read it.

achievements.name: Umbral Diplomacy
achievements.desc: Collect all 22 pages of Umbral Diplomacy in the Shadow Reef.
achievements.tip: Obtain all 22 waterlogged scraps to complete Umbral Diplomacy in The Shadow Reef.

achievements.name: Uncorrupted Ore
achievements.desc: Aid Lady Trahaearn in removing some corruption by smelting 100 corrupted ore.
achievements.tip: Smelt 100 corrupted ore in the Trahaearn Clan furnace, and then claiming the Smithing XP lamp from Lady Trahaearn.

achievements.name: Under Croc and Key
achievements.desc: Gain access to the secret treasure room from 'Crocodile Tears'.
achievements.tip: Access the secret tomb found in Crondis's pyramid after Crocodile Tears.

achievements.name: Unholy Crafting
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to craft unholy symbols.
achievements.tip: Speak with the Spirit of Scorpius after completing the Observatory Quest to unlock the ability to craft unholy symbols. Scorpius can be found near the entrance to the Ourania Runecrafting Altar, north of the Observatory.

achievements.name: Uzer Master
achievements.desc: Clear the shortcut path in the Uzer Mastaba.
achievements.tip: Clear the shortcut found in the Uzer Mastaba, after completing Missing My Mummy.

achievements.name: What's Mine is Also Doric's
achievements.desc: Complete all of the Doric and Boric tasks.
achievements.tip: Complete the Doric's Tasks quest series and Boric's Tasks quest series after completion of What's Mine is Yours.

achievements.name: White Knight Rises
achievements.desc: Achieve the Master White Knight rank.
achievements.tip: Obtain the White Knight rank of Master by killing 1,300 black knights.

achievements.name: Work For Idol Hands
achievements.desc: Give the 6 demon statuettes from Lumbridge Catacombs to Xenia/Ilona at the entrance.
achievements.tip: Hand in all the demon statuettes from the Lumbridge Catacombs. They are sold to Xenia after completing The Blood Pact or Wizard Ilona if Heart of Stone is completed.

achievements.name: You Mistag This Brooch
achievements.desc: Return Mistag's brooch and claim a mining helmet after 'The Lost Tribe'.
achievements.tip: Return Mistag his missing brooch after the quest The Lost Tribe.

achievements.name: You're Not My Real Mah
achievements.desc: Gather elder chronicle fragments in the Elder Halls of Freneskae.
achievements.tip: Unlock all chronicle entries associated with elder chronicles, which requires catching 100 elder chronicles (10 chronicles for each memory). They must be handed in to the monument in Guthixian ruins or offered in the backpack to count towards the achievement.

achievements.name: Zamorakian Expert
achievements.desc: Restored a collection of Zamorakian artefacts.
achievements.tip: Have restored all Zamorakian artefacts from the Infernal Source Dig Site.

achievements.name: Zarosian Expert
achievements.desc: Restored a collection of Zarosian artefacts.
